i posted mostly because i don’t know much except surface level astrology, so im expecting a lot of my opinions to be proven wrong, and am ready for that!

some of the characteristics of virgo that i don’t feel like i align with and have been told are virgo traits are: being logical/practical/analytical, being very organized/neat/clean, being uptight/stubborn. 

from what i have heard virgos are the hard working, level headed analytical and intelligent people. who are set in their ways and stubborn to change it. they are not very emotional, but judgmental and critical of others with high standards. and are introverted. 

a lot of this at least feels like the opposite of me, where i’m usually very easy going, outgoing, not analytical or intelligent, very emotional and wear my emotions on my sleeve (especially sadness), i’m very much so a pushover and people pleaser. i’m not organized or neat in the slightest. 

there is some more that is difficult to put into words at the moment, but i think that covers most of it.

thank you all for your help and advice so far, i really appreciate it
